## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: After an abort, /refine-roadmap supersedes the aborted item with no manual...

The system SHALL ensure that after an abort, /refine-roadmap supersedes the aborted item with no manual edit to checkpoint.json.

#### Scenario: After an abort, /refine-roadmap supersedes the aborted item with no manual...

WHEN `let-refine-roadmap-supersede-aborted-items` is implemented
THEN After an abort, /refine-roadmap supersedes the aborted item with no manual edit to checkpoint.json.

### Requirement: /refine-roadmap still refuses to supersede an in-progress or parked...

The system SHALL ensure that /refine-roadmap still refuses to supersede an in-progress or parked (non-terminal) item and names the abort command in its refusal.

#### Scenario: /refine-roadmap still refuses to supersede an in-progress or parked...

WHEN `let-refine-roadmap-supersede-aborted-items` is implemented
THEN /refine-roadmap still refuses to supersede an in-progress or parked (non-terminal) item and names the abort command in its refusal.
